# Pilot Bible

> A comprehensive aviation education platform offering pilot training courses, career guidance, and community resources for aspiring and professional aviators.

Pilot Bible serves as a central hub for pilot development through structured courses via Skool, curated learning resources, professional pilot stories, and an active community. The platform covers commercial airline pilot pathways (MPL, ATPL), helicopter operations, and flight training financing.

## Key Topics

- Pilot training
- Aviation education
- Airline pilot career
- Flight training costs
- MPL (Multi-Crew Pilot License)
- ATPL (Airline Transport Pilot)
- Helicopter pilot
- Cadet programs
- Aviation safety
- Pilot academies
- Career guidance
- Wizz Air
- Air India
- Flight operations
- Pilot development

## Core Learning & Training

- [Courses](https://pilotbible.com/courses): Online pilot training courses offered through Skool platform
- [Learn](https://pilotbible.com/learn): Learning resources for pilot training, career guidance, and aviation education
- [Home](https://pilotbible.com): Pilot Bible homepage covering pilot training, aviation careers, and pilot stories

## Community & Networking

- [Community](https://pilotbible.com/community): Community hub with live calls, networking, and exclusive resources
- [About](https://pilotbible.com/about): About Pilot Bible aviation education platform and community

## Pilot Stories & Industry Insights

- [Stories](https://pilotbible.com/stories): Pilot stories and career insights from professional aviators
- [Jet2 FlightPath Pilot Selection Process](https://pilotbible.com/2025/06/10): Jet2 FlightPath pilot selection process and training guide
- [Air India B787 Accident Analysis](https://pilotbible.com/2025/06/12): Air India B787 accident analysis and aviation safety perspective
- [Pilot Finances and Flight Training Funding](https://pilotbible.com/2025/07/03): Article on pilot finances and flight training funding costs

## Resources & Products

- [Books](https://pilotbible.com/resources): Book store with pilot guides and aviation career resources
